title: Music
subtitle: classical music, a live concert, lyrics, an album comes out
summary: Talk about the music you like, the people who make it, and how an album is recorded and sold.

lesson.heading: Musical taste
lesson.text: Your **taste** in music is the type of music you like. Everybody's taste is different: you may like **pop music**, your brother **folk music** (music written and played in a traditional style), and your father **classical music**.

examples.text: People's **taste** in music is very different.
I like pop, but my dad prefers **classical music**.

lesson.note: We say classical music, never ~~classic music~~.

lesson.heading: Live music
lesson.text: Groups **perform** (play) at **concerts**. If they play **live**, they play in front of a large group of people, called the **audience**. Some people are not interested in **live performances** and only listen to music at home.

examples.text: We like going to **concerts** to see groups **perform live**.
There was a big **audience** for their last concert.
My dad isn't interested in **live performances**.

left.label: tune
left.text: The **tune** is the musical notes of a song.
examples: I love the **tune** of this song.
I am mostly interested in the **tune**.

right.label: lyrics
right.text: The **lyrics** are the words of a song.
examples: The **lyrics** of this song are very sad.
My brother is more interested in the **lyrics**.

lesson.heading: Instruments and musicians
lesson.note: A flautist is a person who plays the flute.

lesson.heading: People in music
rows: stands in front of an orchestra and leads it
a large group of musicians who play different instruments
sings opera, a play in which the words are sung
sings or plays alone, not in a group

lesson.heading: Making an album
lesson.text: Groups **record** an **album** (eight or ten songs in one collection) or a **single** (one song). They do it in a **recording studio**. When the album **comes out**, people can buy it, and it is usually **advertised** in the media.

examples.text: Their new album was **recorded** in a **studio** near my home.
The new album **comes out** next week.
The album is being **advertised** on TV.
Many people **download** their favourite **tracks** from the Internet.
examples.note: a track = one song from an album

lesson.text: Many words for musicians end in *-ist*: a guitar - a guitarist, a violin - a violinist, a cello - a cellist.

exercises.prompt: Match the words on the left with the words on the right.
Match each musician with the instrument they play.
There was a very big ___ for their last concert - nearly 10,000 people.
exercises.explanation: The audience is the large group of people who watch or listen to a performance.

exercises.prompt: I think their new ___ is a great song.
exercises.explanation: A single is one song; an album is a collection of eight or ten songs.

exercises.prompt: The new ___ has songs written by other people.
exercises.explanation: An album is eight or ten songs in one collection.

exercises.prompt: The album is finished. It ___ out next week.
exercises.explanation: When an album comes out, people can buy it.

exercises.prompt: I've listened to a lot of their music but I've never seen them perform ___.
exercises.explanation: To perform live is to play in front of a large group of people.

exercises.prompt: Their new album was ___ in a studio near my home.
exercises.explanation: Groups record an album in a recording studio.

exercises.prompt: The band has a new album out and it's being ___ on TV.
exercises.explanation: A new album is usually advertised in the media, for example on TV.

exercises.prompt: The Berlin Philharmonic is a large group of musicians who play different instruments. What is it?
exercises.explanation: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play different instruments.

exercises.prompt: Herbert von Karajan stood in front of that orchestra and led it. He was a ___.
exercises.explanation: A conductor stands in front of an orchestra and conducts it.

exercises.prompt: Rachmaninoff wrote classical music. He was a famous ___.
exercises.explanation: A composer is someone who writes music, usually classical music.

exercises.prompt: Is each word a person or a thing?

exercises.statement: Yo Yo Ma plays the cello, so he is a great classical cellist.
exercises.explanation: Correct. A person who plays the cello is a cellist.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the right order to talk about opera.
exercises.answer: Puccini composed operas such as La Boheme
exercises.explanation: An opera is a play in which the words are sung; a composer composes it.
